meta.text: Option A is the tempting one: keep the current cluster and just enable Photon. The upside is a very easy rollout — no infrastructure change at all — and Photon's vectorized engine will genuinely speed up your CPU-bound stages. But notice the trap: Photon has a higher DBU rate, so if your job is I/O-bound, you pay more per hour for almost no gain. It also does nothing to address the three-x growth.
